about_the_game:
Sensational Grand Tour of America by Sea, River & Road!

As Cruise Director in charge help tourists enjoy the Ultimate Grand Tour of the USA. Port Canaveral to New York, Boston & New England. Visit Canada, Niagara Falls & the Great Lakes aboard the fleetÂ’s superb flagship, USS Liberty of the Waves. Take a sensational Mississippi Riverboat trip to New Orleans. Drive funky Rte 66 to Santa Monica then jump on a Pacific Cruise to Hawaii.

Arrange exciting Excursions throughout the Cruise & a Wedding! Visit sensational Tourist Attractions. See famous Landmarks, enjoy Pacific and Atlantic highlights. Help passengers with Cabins, Shopping, Dining, Leisure on board and at Ports of Call along the way. Collect Cruise Souvenirs.

Look for hundreds of hidden objects and Luxury items Lost by Passengers. Play superb Mini-Games, take Photos, earn Merit Badges for your Achievements. Cruise Director 8 CE includes 3 modes (Casual, Challenge, Extreme) of truly captivating, hour upon hour gameplay for Families and literally All ages to enjoy.
